title: Vasya And The Matrix
statementMd:
Now Vasya is taking an exam in mathematics. In order to get a good mark, Vasya needs to guess the matrix that the teacher has constructed!

Vasya knows that the matrix consists of $*n*$ rows and $*m*$ columns. For each row, he knows the xor (bitwise excluding or) of the elements in this row. The sequence $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ denotes the xor of elements in rows with indices $1$, $2$, ..., $*n*$, respectively. Similarly, for each column, he knows the xor of the elements in this column. The sequence $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*m*}$ denotes the xor of elements in columns with indices $1$, $2$, ..., $*m*$, respectively.

Help Vasya! Find a matrix satisfying the given constraints or tell him that there is no suitable matrix.

## Input

The first line contains two numbers $*n*$ and $*m* (2 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 100)$ — the dimensions of the matrix.

The second line contains $*n*$ numbers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*} (0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$, where $*a*_{*i*}$ is the xor of all elements in row $*i*$.

The third line contains $*m*$ numbers $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*m*} (0 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$, where $*b*_{*i*}$ is the xor of all elements in column $*i*$.

## Output

If there is no matrix satisfying the given constraints in the first line, output "NO".

Otherwise, on the first line output "YES", and then $*n*$ rows of $*m*$ numbers in each $*c*_{*i*1}, *c*_{*i*2}, ... , *c*_{*im*} (0 ≤ *c*_{*ij*} ≤ 2·10^{9})$ — the description of the matrix.

If there are several suitable matrices, it is allowed to print any of them.
statementZhMd:
现在 Vasya 正在参加数学考试。为了取得好成绩，Vasya 需要猜出老师构造的矩阵！

Vasya 知道矩阵由 $*n*$ 行和 $*m*$ 列组成。对于每一行，他都知道该行所有元素的异或（按位排他或）结果。序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ 分别表示下标为 $1$、$2$、...、$*n*$ 的行中元素的异或结果。类似地，对于每一列，他也知道该列所有元素的异或结果。序列 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*m*}$ 分别表示下标为 $1$、$2$、...、$*m*$ 的列中元素的异或结果。

请帮助 Vasya！找出一个满足给定条件的矩阵，或者告诉他不存在这样的矩阵。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个数 $*n*$ 和 $*m* (2 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 100)$ —— 矩阵的行数和列数。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*} (0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$，其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 行所有元素的异或结果。

第三行包含 $*m*$ 个数 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*m*} (0 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$，其中 $*b*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 列所有元素的异或结果。

## 输出格式

如果不存在满足给定条件的矩阵，在第一行输出 `NO`。

否则，在第一行输出 `YES`，然后输出 $*n*$ 行，每行包含 $*m*$ 个数 $*c*_{*i*1}, *c*_{*i*2}, ... , *c*_{*im*} (0 ≤ *c*_{*ij*} ≤ 2·10^{9})$ —— 矩阵的描述。

如果有多个满足条件的矩阵，输出其中任意一个即可。
